headline._: A quiet day. No new fact moves the story; Romania notified 17,416 public bodies.
headline.exec: Nothing new for you. Still no organisation says it was hit; the fix is out and CISA's deadline is tomorrow, 29 October.
headline.general: Nothing new for you. If someone runs your website, ask them if it is updated.
headline.security: Nothing moved the measures. Two Bangladesh shutdowns joined the precaution list; Romania's DNSC notified 17,416 public bodies. No organisation is tied to php2shell.
headline.engineer: Nothing new to install. Exploited stays official (CISA); confirm the fixed version is what is running.
headline.journalist: Still no organisation confirmed hacked, as of 17:15 UTC. Coverage today is CISA's listing reported in new languages, not new facts.
headline.researcher: 675 sources by 17:15 UTC; 8 published today. No new compromise row; two offline rows (Bangladesh).

items.text: Two precautionary shutdowns join the offline list: Bangladesh Bank and three banks' websites, and the land ministry's digital land services. The events were 22 to 24 October; the newsroom had them on 28 October. Precautions, not evidence of an attack.
items.src: The Daily Star; the journalist (08:40 wake)

items.text: Romania's national cybersecurity directorate, DNSC, is reported to have notified 17,416 public-sector bodies about the flaws: a count of bodies told, not of bodies vulnerable or hit. The page lists hospitals, transport, energy, utilities and local administration; the journalist checked its capture at 13:44 UTC.
items.src: Știrile PRO TV (citing News.ro and DNSC), checked by the journalist

items.text: No organisation is named as compromised through php2shell. The journalist re-read every new capture on each wake and nothing changed that.
